_comment: Homepage copy rendered twice: prerendered by apps/site (HomeContent.astro, what crawlers read) and live by apps/worker/web/Landing.tsx, where the channel word cycles. Both read this file so the two can never drift; apps/site/scripts/verify-build.mjs checks the prerendered markup against it. pricingFacts carries the competitor pricing claims (sourced from the August 2026 audit in /guides/free-website-annotation-tools) — update it here when a vendor's pricing changes.
pricingFacts: Markup.io discontinued its free tier in 2025 and moved Pro to $79/month. BugHerd, Marker.io, Volley, Feedbucket and Usersnap have no permanent free plan at all, only trials.
